    5   def pbCanChooseMove?(idxBattler, idxMove, showMessages, sleepTalk = false)
    6     battler = @battlers[idxBattler]
    7     move = battler.moves[idxMove]
    8     return false unless move
    9     if move.pp == 0 && move.total_pp > 0 && !sleepTalk
   10       pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("There's no PP left for this move!")) if showMessages
   11       return false
   12     end
   13     if battler.effects[PBEffects::Encore] > 0
   14       idxEncoredMove = battler.pbEncoredMoveIndex
   15       return false if idxEncoredMove >= 0 && idxMove != idxEncoredMove
   16     end
   17     return battler.pbCanChooseMove?(move, true, showMessages, sleepTalk)
   18   end

   20   def pbCanChooseAnyMove?(idxBattler, sleepTalk = false)
   21     battler = @battlers[idxBattler]
   22     battler.eachMoveWithIndex do |m, i|
   23       next if m.pp == 0 && m.total_pp > 0 && !sleepTalk
   24       if battler.effects[PBEffects::Encore] > 0
   25         idxEncoredMove = battler.pbEncoredMoveIndex
   26         next if idxEncoredMove >= 0 && i != idxEncoredMove
   27       end
   28       next if !battler.pbCanChooseMove?(m, true, false, sleepTalk)
   29       return true
   30     end
   31     return false
   32   end

   34   # Called when the Pokémon is Encored, or if it can't use any of its moves.
   35   # Makes the Pokémon use the Encored move (if Encored), or Struggle.
   36   def pbAutoChooseMove(idxBattler, showMessages = true)
   37     battler = @battlers[idxBattler]
   38     if battler.fainted?
   39       pbClearChoice(idxBattler)
   40       return true
   41     end
   42     # Encore
   43     idxEncoredMove = battler.pbEncoredMoveIndex
   44     if idxEncoredMove >= 0 && pbCanChooseMove?(idxBattler, idxEncoredMove, false)
   45       encoreMove = battler.moves[idxEncoredMove]
   46       @choices[idxBattler][0] = :UseMove         # "Use move"
   47       @choices[idxBattler][1] = idxEncoredMove   # Index of move to be used
   48       @choices[idxBattler][2] = encoreMove       # Battle::Move object
   49       @choices[idxBattler][3] = -1               # No target chosen yet
   50       return true if singleBattle?
   51       if pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler)
   52         if showMessages
   53           pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} has to use {2}!", battler.name, encoreMove.name))
   54         end
   55         return pbChooseTarget(battler, encoreMove)
   56       end
   57       return true
   58     end
   59     # Struggle
   60     if pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler) && showMessages
   61       pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} has no moves left!", battler.name))
   62     end
   63     @choices[idxBattler][0] = :UseMove    # "Use move"
   64     @choices[idxBattler][1] = -1          # Index of move to be used
   65     @choices[idxBattler][2] = @struggle   # Struggle Battle::Move object
   66     @choices[idxBattler][3] = -1          # No target chosen yet
   67     return true
   68   end

   70   def pbRegisterMove(idxBattler, idxMove, showMessages = true)
   71     battler = @battlers[idxBattler]
   72     move = battler.moves[idxMove]
   73     return false if !pbCanChooseMove?(idxBattler, idxMove, showMessages)
   74     @choices[idxBattler][0] = :UseMove   # "Use move"
   75     @choices[idxBattler][1] = idxMove    # Index of move to be used
   76     @choices[idxBattler][2] = move       # Battle::Move object
   77     @choices[idxBattler][3] = -1         # No target chosen yet
   78     return true
   79   end

   81   def pbChoseMove?(idxBattler, moveID)
   82     return false if !@battlers[idxBattler] || @battlers[idxBattler].fainted?
   83     if @choices[idxBattler][0] == :UseMove && @choices[idxBattler][1]
   84       return @choices[idxBattler][2].id == moveID
   85     end
   86     return false
   87   end

   89   def pbChoseMoveFunctionCode?(idxBattler, code)
   90     return false if @battlers[idxBattler].fainted?
   91     if @choices[idxBattler][0] == :UseMove && @choices[idxBattler][1]
   92       return @choices[idxBattler][2].function_code == code
   93     end
   94     return false
   95   end

  101   # Returns whether the idxTarget will be targeted by a move with target_data
  102   # used by a battler in idxUser.
  103   def pbMoveCanTarget?(idxUser, idxTarget, target_data)
  104     return false if target_data.num_targets == 0
  105     case target_data.id
  106     when :NearAlly
  107       return false if opposes?(idxUser, idxTarget)
  108       return false if !nearBattlers?(idxUser, idxTarget)
  109     when :UserOrNearAlly
  110       return true if idxUser == idxTarget
  111       return false if opposes?(idxUser, idxTarget)
  112       return false if !nearBattlers?(idxUser, idxTarget)
  113     when :AllAllies
  114       return false if idxUser == idxTarget
  115       return false if opposes?(idxUser, idxTarget)
  116     when :UserAndAllies
  117       return false if opposes?(idxUser, idxTarget)
  118     when :NearFoe, :RandomNearFoe, :AllNearFoes
  119       return false if !opposes?(idxUser, idxTarget)
  120       return false if !nearBattlers?(idxUser, idxTarget)
  121     when :Foe
  122       return false if !opposes?(idxUser, idxTarget)
  123     when :AllFoes
  124       return false if !opposes?(idxUser, idxTarget)
  125     when :NearOther, :AllNearOthers
  126       return false if !nearBattlers?(idxUser, idxTarget)
  127     when :Other
  128       return false if idxUser == idxTarget
  129     end
  130     return true
  131   end

  133   #=============================================================================
  134   # Turn order calculation (priority)
  135   #=============================================================================
  136   def pbCalculatePriority(fullCalc = false, indexArray = nil)
  137     needRearranging = false
  138     if fullCalc
  139       @priorityTrickRoom = (@field.effects[PBEffects::TrickRoom] > 0)
  140       # Recalculate everything from scratch
  141       randomOrder = Array.new(maxBattlerIndex + 1) { |i| i }
  142       (randomOrder.length - 1).times do |i|   # Can't use shuffle! here
  143         r = i + pbRandom(randomOrder.length - i)
  144         randomOrder[i], randomOrder[r] = randomOrder[r], randomOrder[i]
  145       end
  146       @priority.clear
  147       (0..maxBattlerIndex).each do |i|
  148         b = @battlers[i]
  149         next if !b
  150         # [battler, speed, sub-priority from ability, sub-priority from item,
  151         #  final sub-priority, priority, tie-breaker order]
  152         entry = [b, b.pbSpeed, 0, 0, 0, 0, randomOrder[i]]
  153         if @choices[b.index][0] == :UseMove || @choices[b.index][0] == :Shift
  154           # Calculate move's priority
  155           if @choices[b.index][0] == :UseMove
  156             move = @choices[b.index][2]
  157             pri = move.pbPriority(b)
  158             if b.abilityActive?
  159               pri = Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerPriorityChange(b.ability, b, move, pri)
  160             end
  161             entry[5] = pri
  162             @choices[b.index][4] = pri
  163           end
  164           # Calculate sub-priority changes (first/last within priority bracket)
  165           # Abilities (Stall)
  166           if b.abilityActive?
  167             entry[2] = Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerPriorityBracketChange(b.ability, b, self)
  168           end
  169           # Items (Quick Claw, Custap Berry, Lagging Tail, Full Incense)
  170           if b.itemActive?
  171             entry[3] = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerPriorityBracketChange(b.item, b, self)
  172           end
  173         end
  174         @priority.push(entry)
  175       end
  176       needRearranging = true
  177     else
  178       if (@field.effects[PBEffects::TrickRoom] > 0) != @priorityTrickRoom
  179         needRearranging = true
  180         @priorityTrickRoom = (@field.effects[PBEffects::TrickRoom] > 0)
  181       end
  182       # Recheck all battler speeds and changes to priority caused by abilities
  183       @priority.each do |entry|
  184         next if !entry
  185         next if indexArray && !indexArray.include?(entry[0].index)
  186         # Recalculate speed of battler
  187         newSpeed = entry[0].pbSpeed
  188         needRearranging = true if newSpeed != entry[1]
  189         entry[1] = newSpeed
  190         # Recalculate move's priority in case ability has changed
  191         choice = @choices[entry[0].index]
  192         if choice[0] == :UseMove
  193           move = choice[2]
  194           pri = move.pbPriority(entry[0])
  195           if entry[0].abilityActive?
  196             pri = Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerPriorityChange(entry[0].ability, entry[0], move, pri)
  197           end
  198           needRearranging = true if pri != entry[5]
  199           entry[5] = pri
  200           choice[4] = pri
  201         end
  202         # NOTE: If the battler's ability at the start of this round was one with
  203         #       a PriorityBracketChange handler (i.e. Quick Draw), but it Mega
  204         #       Evolved and now doesn't have that ability, that old ability's
  205         #       priority bracket modifier will still apply. Similarly, if its
  206         #       old ability did not have a PriorityBracketChange handler but it
  207         #       Mega Evolved and now does have it, it will not apply this round.
  208         #       This is because the message saying that it had an effect appears
  209         #       before Mega Evolution happens, and recalculating it now would
  210         #       make that message inaccurate because Quick Draw only has a
  211         #       chance of triggering. However, since Quick Draw is exclusive to
  212         #       a species that doesn't Mega Evolve, these circumstances should
  213         #       never arise and no one will notice that the priority bracket
  214         #       change isn't recalculated when technically it should be.
  215       end
  216     end
  217     # Calculate each battler's overall sub-priority, and whether its ability or
  218     # item is responsible
  219     # NOTE: Going fast beats going slow. A Pokémon with Stall and Quick Claw
  220     #       will go first in its priority bracket if Quick Claw triggers,
  221     #       regardless of Stall.
  222     @priority.each do |entry|
  223       entry[0].effects[PBEffects::PriorityAbility] = false
  224       entry[0].effects[PBEffects::PriorityItem] = false
  225       subpri = entry[2]   # Sub-priority from ability
  226       if (subpri == 0 && entry[3] != 0) ||   # Ability has no effect, item has effect
  227          (subpri < 0 && entry[3] >= 1)   # Ability makes it slower, item makes it faster
  228         subpri = entry[3]   # Sub-priority from item
  229         entry[0].effects[PBEffects::PriorityItem] = true
  230       elsif subpri != 0   # Ability has effect, item had superfluous/no effect
  231         entry[0].effects[PBEffects::PriorityAbility] = true
  232       end
  233       entry[4] = subpri   # Final sub-priority
  234     end
  235     # Reorder the priority array
  236     if needRearranging
  237       @priority.sort! do |a, b|
  238         if a[5] != b[5]
  239           # Sort by priority (highest value first)
  240           b[5] <=> a[5]
  241         elsif a[4] != b[4]
  242           # Sort by sub-priority (highest value first)
  243           b[4] <=> a[4]
  244         elsif @priorityTrickRoom
  245           # Sort by speed (lowest first), and use tie-breaker if necessary
  246           (a[1] == b[1]) ? b[6] <=> a[6] : a[1] <=> b[1]
  247         else
  248           # Sort by speed (highest first), and use tie-breaker if necessary
  249           (a[1] == b[1]) ? b[6] <=> a[6] : b[1] <=> a[1]
  250         end
  251       end
  252       # Write the priority order to the debug log
  253       if fullCalc && $INTERNAL
  254         logMsg = "[Round order] "
  255         @priority.each_with_index do |entry, i|
  256           logMsg += ", " if i > 0
  257           logMsg += "#{entry[0].pbThis(i > 0)} (#{entry[0].index})"
  258         end
  259         PBDebug.log(logMsg)
  260       end
  261     end
  262   end

  264   def pbPriority(onlySpeedSort = false)
  265     ret = []
  266     if onlySpeedSort
  267       # Sort battlers by their speed stats and tie-breaker order only.
  268       tempArray = []
  269       @priority.each { |pArray| tempArray.push([pArray[0], pArray[1], pArray[6]]) }
  270       tempArray.sort! { |a, b| (a[1] == b[1]) ? b[2] <=> a[2] : b[1] <=> a[1] }
  271       tempArray.each { |tArray| ret.push(tArray[0]) }
  272     else
  273       # Sort battlers by priority, sub-priority and their speed. Ties are
  274       # resolved in the same way each time this method is called in a round.
  275       @priority.each { |pArray| ret.push(pArray[0]) if !pArray[0].fainted? }
  276     end
  277     return ret
  278   end
  279 end
